# GSoC 2026 Project Ideas

Welcome! Read our contributor guide first. We do not accept proposals written entirely by AI tools; you may use AI to check spelling, but you must disclose it.

## Project 1: Faster trajectory readers

### Summary
Speed up reading of large trajectory files by using memory mapping.

### Expected Outcomes
A new reader class with benchmarks and docs.

### Relevant Skills
Python, NumPy, some C

### Possible Mentors
Alice Example (@alice), Bob Example

### Expected Size of Project
350 hours

### Difficulty Rating
Medium

### Related issues/PRs
https://github.com/example/lib/issues/12
https://github.com/example/lib/pull/40
